work_item: BB-MATH-DATA B03 exact descriptive statistics to same-case context explanation
route_method: The integration test starts the actual minidora-rust binary in fresh child processes. The engine unit tests rederive the report and simulate an interrupted production file effect at the adopted pre-confirmation journal edge.

route_observations.consumer_behavior: Recomputes Statistics from the retained input_values/input_units, compares the typed report and complete pretty-serialized bytes, and emits a compact explanation that cites the supplied values and exact result fields.
route_observations.consumer_dependency: The explanation result depends on the exact prior result ID; its MeaningIR context_result_ref points to that same result.
route_observations.consumer_scope: The existing report scope is copied and states that no inference is made about population representativeness or causal effects.
route_observations.tampering_behavior: Replacing the stored mean 1/5 with 2/5 causes exact recomputation mismatch and MATH_CONTEXT_INVALID.
route_observations.file_recovery: The recovery unit test retains the actual rendered file and an UNKNOWN action at the adopted pre-confirmation edge. Reconcile returns COMMIT with the same prior-result dependency, CONFIRMED receipt, one unchanged action identity, unchanged bytes and unchanged modification time; no write is resent.

remaining_scope: Only descriptive Statistics JSON reports use this explanation path; other B03 report types still fall through to their prior surface.
Ordinary open-domain language Q&A and free-form writing remain BUILD_GAPs.
B03 and B06 acceptance remain UNVERIFIED.
